summary: ARTFUL iter-4 verification of the 17-item fix/feature batch. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (newsletter subscribe new/dup/invalid, legal pages shipping/returns/privacy/terms 200, about/our-story/contact/corporate-gifting removed from /api/pages -> 404, /api/cms/page/corporate-gifting hero+body_html, /api/cms/page/contact contact fields present, /api/track/visit persists visit_count/last_path and /api/admin/visitors returns stats.total>0, /api/admin/orders/{order_number} returns address dict + items with gift_wrap+wrap_price, Razorpay real order created dev_mode:false with rzp_test key_id, COD full flow with gift wrap totals consistent, PUT /api/admin/cms/pages/contact persists all 5 contact fields, PUT body_html persists for about/our-story/corporate-gifting, manual collection returns exact product_ids and dynamic collection filters by badge rule). Frontend: newsletter footer valid submit shows newsletter-thankyou popup (invalid blocked by HTML5 email validity); legal pages /returns /privacy /terms /shipping render rich HTML with headings; /about /our-story /contact /corporate-gifting render substantive CMS-driven bodies; admin login works via data-testid; Dashboard recent orders (4) click opens modal exposing data-testid=admin-order-address AND 'Gift Wrapping' text; Visitors page shows data table with 6 rows + search input; Refunds page has table with columns 'Order/Amount/Reason/Cancelled / Requested on/Status/Update' and status filter select with All statuses/Requested/Approved/Processing/Completed/Rejected; SitePages has About/Our Story/Contact/Corporate Gifting tabs and sitepage-contact_address/phone/whatsapp/email/office_hours testids all present; Collections editor cf-type select works, cf-rules shown when type=dynamic, cf-products (with searchable product input) shown when type=manual; Products/Inventory/Categories/Legal Pages/FAQs all use data tables with search; Checkout addr-state is SELECT with 37 options (Indian States dropdown) and addr-city is free-text INPUT; pincode/phone strip non-digits ('abc123xyz456789' -> '123456', 'abc987xyz' -> '987'); checkout-giftwrap line shows 'Gift Wrapping ₹199' when cart item has gift wrap; place-order-btn disabled until authenticated.

critical_code_review_comments: Refunds page currently has zero rows so the actual date+time formatting (e.g. dd Mon yyyy, HH:mm) could not be visually verified from real data — recommend a smoke row seeded in a future test or verify with a cancelled order that generated a refund request.
AdminLogin.js email input has no `type` attribute; consider adding `type="email"` for consistency and accessibility (does not affect functionality since data-testid=admin-email works).

Footer newsletter uses native HTML5 `type=email` which blocks form submit on invalid email before the JS `isValidEmail` toast can fire; the current UX shows a native browser tooltip. That may or may not be intentional but is acceptable.

public_settings() strips only fields starting with 'cost_' via a loop over a single-item tuple — the pop('cost_') is a no-op unless there's an exact key 'cost_'. Consider a proper prefix filter or a regex if the intent was to hide cost fields.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@artful.com / Artful@2026; Customer via DEV OTP (dev_otp in /api/auth/otp/send response).
seed_data_creation: 22 test rows across newsletter subscribers (TEST_*@x.com), visitors (vt_*), COD orders (razorpay+cod incl. gift-wrapped), CMS site pages (about/our-story/corporate-gifting body_html + contact fields overwritten to TEST-ADDR-*), and admin collections (test-manual-*, test-dyn-*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login uses data-testid=admin-email/admin-password/admin-login-btn (email input has no type=email attribute). Dashboard row click opens modal without role=dialog — use data-testid=admin-order-address as the anchor. Product URLs are /products/<slug> (not /product/). Cookie banner intercepts clicks — always click 'Accept All' before interacting. Note: legal pages seed intentionally deletes about/our-story/contact/corporate-gifting so GET /api/pages/{those} returns 404 by design; the CMS versions live under /api/cms/page/*.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 17 items pass. Backend 22/22 pytest, frontend flows all green.
